text: Calling about my son, he's 3. He's had a temperature since yesterday afternoon and it's 39 now. About half an hour ago I noticed some small dark red and purplish spots on his legs and a couple on his chest. I pressed a glass against them like you're supposed to and they didn't go away, I could still see them clearly through the glass. The other thing is his breathing. It's much quicker than normal, and when I lift his top you can see the skin pulling in under his ribs each time he breathes in. Every so often he makes a little grunting noise at the end of a breath. I've been watching him for about ten minutes to make sure I wasn't imagining it and it hasn't eased off. I'm not panicking but I wanted to describe it properly and see what you advise, because I'm happy to take him straight in if that's what's needed.
